Hallelujah! How good it is to sing praises to our God, how pleasant and lovely to praise Him!
Give praise to the Lord; for it is good to make melody to our God; praise is pleasing and beautiful.
你們要讚美耶和華！因歌頌我們的神為善為美；讚美的話是合宜的。
The LORD builds up Jerusalem; He gathers the exiles of Israel.
The Lord is building up Jerusalem; he makes all the outlaws of Israel come together.
耶和華建造耶路撒冷，聚集以色列中被趕散的人。
He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds.
He makes the broken-hearted well, and puts oil on their wounds.
他醫好傷心的人，裹好他們的傷處。
He determines the number of the stars; He calls them each by name.
He sees the number of the stars; he gives them all their names.
他數點星宿的數目，一一稱他的名。
Great is our Lord, and mighty in power; His understanding has no limit.
Great is our Lord, and great his power; there is no limit to his wisdom.
我們的主為大，最有能力；他的智慧無法測度。
The LORD sustains the humble, but casts the wicked to the ground.
The Lord gives help to the poor in spirit; but he sends sinners down in shame.
耶和華扶持謙卑人，將惡人傾覆於地。
Sing to the LORD with thanksgiving; make music on the harp to our God,
Make songs of praise to the Lord; make melody to our God with instruments of music.
你們要以感謝向耶和華歌唱，用琴向我們的神歌頌。
who covers the sky with clouds, who prepares rain for the earth, who makes grass to grow on the hills.
By his hand the heaven is covered with clouds and rain is stored up for the earth; he makes the grass tall on the mountains.
他用雲遮天，為地降雨，使草生長在山上。
He provides food for the animals, and for the young ravens when they call.
He gives food to every beast, and to the young ravens in answer to their cry.
他賜食給走獸和啼叫的小烏鴉。
He does not delight in the strength of the horse; He takes no pleasure in the legpower of the man.
He has no delight in the strength of a horse; he takes no pleasure in the legs of a man.
他不喜悅馬的力大，不喜愛人的腿快。
The LORD is pleased with those who fear Him, who hope in His loving devotion.
The Lord takes pleasure in his worshippers, and in those whose hope is in his mercy.
耶和華喜愛敬畏他和盼望他慈愛的人。
Exalt the LORD, O Jerusalem; praise your God, O Zion!
Give praise to the Lord, O Jerusalem; give praise to your God, O Zion.
耶路撒冷啊，你要頌讚耶和華！錫安哪，你要讚美你的神！
For He strengthens the bars of your gates and blesses the children within you.
He has made strong the iron bands of your doors; he has sent blessings on your children inside your walls.
因為他堅固了你的門閂，賜福給你中間的兒女。
He makes peace at your borders; He fills you with the finest wheat.
He gives peace in all your land, making your stores full of fat grain.
他使你境內平安，用上好的麥子使你滿足。
He sends forth His command to the earth; His word runs swiftly.
He sends out his orders to the earth; his word goes out quickly.
他發命在地；他的話頒行最快。
He spreads the snow like wool; He scatters the frost like ashes;
He gives snow like wool; he sends out ice-drops like dust.
他降雪如羊毛，撒霜如爐灰。
He casts forth His hail like pebbles. Who can withstand His icy blast?
He sends down ice like raindrops: water is made hard by his cold.
他擲下冰雹如碎渣；他發出寒冷，誰能當得起呢？
He sends forth His word and melts them; He unleashes His winds, and the waters flow.
At the outgoing of his word, the ice is turned to water; when he sends out his wind, there is a flowing of waters.
他一出令，這些就都消化；他使風颳起，水便流動。
He declares His word to Jacob, His statutes and judgments to Israel.
He makes his word clear to Jacob, teaching Israel his laws and his decisions.
他將他的道指示雅各，將他的律例典章指示以色列。
He has done this for no other nation; they do not know His judgments. Hallelujah!
He has not done these things for any other nation: and as for his laws, they have no knowledge of them. Let the Lord be praised.
別國他都沒有這樣待過；至於他的典章，他們向來沒有知道。你們要讚美耶和華！
